edition.cue: Serve the mains when the lobsters escape behind the fridge.

s.note: catch them first, they will escape
s.how: Chop 300g cooked lobster meat and fold with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, the juice of half a lemon, 1 finely diced celery stick and chopped chives. Cut 16 rounds from buttered brioche slices and toast. Pile the lobster on top.

Mash 800g boiled potatoes with 2 onions fried slowly in 40g butter, salt and pepper. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 8 squares, fill, pinch closed into rounds, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

m.how: Steam 500g sliced pastrami for 10 minutes until glossy. Spread 8 slices soft white bread with 80g mayonnaise, add shredded iceberg lettuce and 2 sliced tomatoes, and pile the pastrami high. Alvy would want rye and mustard, so have them on the side.

w.note: Alvy's city, which he will never leave
w.how: Crush 200g digestive biscuits with 80g melted butter and press into a 22cm tin. Beat 900g cream cheese with 220g caster sugar, 200g sour cream, 4 eggs and the zest of 1 lemon. Pour over and bake in a water bath at 150C for 70 minutes. Cool in the oven, then chill overnight.

d.note: Fresh cucumber and lime juice shaken with mint and honey, topped with sparkling water over ice.
d.how: Blend 1 chopped Lebanese cucumber with 60ml lime juice, 2 tbsp honey and a handful of mint until smooth, then strain. Fill 4 glasses with ice and cucumber ribbons. Pour 60ml of the mix into each and top with 150ml sparkling water. Add a mint sprig.
